description_en: Retrieves the current content and available download URLs of a document or semantic model
description_zh: 读取文档或语义模型的当前内容及可用的下载地址
name: GetKnowledgeObject

parameters.help_en: The ID of the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the long-term business object
parameters.name: knowledge_object_id

parameters.help_en: Supported only for models. Specifies the version to read. If omitted, the published version is preferred. Otherwise, the latest version is used
parameters.help_zh: 仅模型支持；指定读取版本。省略时优先已发布版本，否则最新版本
parameters.name: version_no

Code.description_en: The business error code, which is used to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

Content.description_en: The current valid typed knowledge content. Returns a document or semantic model structure based on the type
Content.description_zh: 当前有效的类型化知识内容；按 Type 返回文档或语义模型结构

Document.description_en: The document content. This field exists only when Type is set to DOCUMENT

ContentFormat.description_en: Required when Text exists. In the initial release, valid values are MARKDOWN and TEXT
ContentFormat.description_zh: Text 存在时必填，首期 MARKDOWN 或 TEXT

Text.description_en: The public current document body. This field is optional. It is omitted when parsing is incomplete, unauthorized, or cannot be provided completely and securely. A single retrieval snippet is not treated as the entire document
Text.description_zh: 可公开的当前文档正文，可选；尚未完成解析、未授权或无法完整、安全地提供时省略，不把单个检索片段冒充整篇文档

SemanticModel.description_en: The semantic model content. This field exists only when Type is set to SEMANTIC_MODEL

Datasets.description_en: The logical datasets contained in the model. An empty array is returned if no public datasets are available
Datasets.description_zh: 模型包含的逻辑数据集；没有可公开数据集时为空数组

Description.description_en: The business description of the dataset. This field is optional

EntityId.description_en: The entity ID of the DataWorks Data Map table. This field is returned when a reliable association exists. It is retained when an existing dataset with the same name is not passed. Submitted values are processed according to the semantic layer saving rules
EntityId.description_zh: DataWorks 数据地图表实体 ID；有可靠关联时返回；既有同名数据集未传时保留，提交值按语义层保存规则处理

Fields.description_en: The defined and publicly accessible fields of the dataset. An empty array is returned if no field definitions are provided
Fields.description_zh: 数据集已定义且允许公开的字段；未提供字段定义时为空数组

DataType.description_en: The data type of the field. This field must be provided for public model fields and is not inferred by the server
DataType.description_zh: 字段数据类型；公开的模型字段必须提供，不由服务端猜测

Description.description_en: The business description of the field. This field is optional

Name.description_en: The name of the dataset within the model, used for relationship positioning within the current model
Name.description_zh: 模型内的数据集名称，在本模型内用于关系定位

PrimaryKey.description_en: The explicitly declared primary key field name. This field is optional. Each item must exist in the Fields of the current dataset
PrimaryKey.description_zh: 已明确声明的主键字段名，可选；每项必须存在于本数据集 Fields

items.description_en: The explicitly declared primary key field name. This field is optional. Each item must exist in the Fields of the current dataset
items.description_zh: 已明确声明的主键字段名，可选；每项必须存在于本数据集 Fields

Metrics.description_en: The executable metrics in the model. An empty array is returned if no metrics are available. Metrics with only candidate formulas are not included
Metrics.description_zh: 模型中可执行的指标；没有时为空数组，不混入只有候选公式的指标

DatasetName.description_en: The name of the SemanticDataset to which the metric belongs. This name must be locatable in the Datasets of the current model
DatasetName.description_zh: 所属 SemanticDataset.Name，必须能在本模型 Datasets 中定位

Description.description_en: The description of the metric definition. This field is optional

Expression.description_en: The executable expression, which must contain at least one dialect version. It is not auto-generated by the model
Expression.description_zh: 可执行表达式，必须包含至少一个方言版本；不由模型补写

Dialects.description_en: The expressions of the same metric in different SQL dialects. At least one item is required. The same dialect must not be repeated
Dialects.description_zh: 同一指标在不同 SQL 方言下的表达式，至少一项；同一方言不重复

Dialect.description_en: The SQL dialect, such as MaxCompute or ANSI_SQL
Dialect.description_zh: SQL 方言，例如 MaxCompute 或 ANSI_SQL

Sql.description_en: The non-empty calculation expression in the specified dialect. It is not a complete query statement
Sql.description_zh: 该方言下的非空计算表达式，不是完整查询语句

Unit.description_en: The explicitly declared unit of the metric. This field is optional. It is not returned when no reliable source is available
Unit.description_zh: 明确声明的指标单位，可选；没有可靠来源时不返回

Relationships.description_en: The defined relationships in the model expressed by field pairs. An empty array is returned if no relationships are available. Relationships are not inferred from graph paths
Relationships.description_zh: 模型内已定义且可用字段配对表达的关联关系；没有时为空数组，不从图路径猜测

FromDataset.description_en: The SemanticDataset.Name of the starting point

JoinKeys.description_en: The equi-join pairs of fields at both ends. At least one item is required. Composite joins are listed pair by pair
JoinKeys.description_zh: 两端字段的等值关联配对，至少一项；复合关联按配对逐项列出

Name.description_en: The name of the relationship within the current model

ToDataset.description_en: The SemanticDataset.Name of the ending point

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the object was first created. This field is not returned for existing objects whose creation time cannot be reliably determined
CreateTime.description_zh: 对象首次形成时间；无法可靠确定的存量对象不返回

Description.description_en: The brief description, which is editable. Pass an empty string to clear this field
Description.description_zh: 简述，可编辑；传空字符串可清空

DownloadFiles.description_en: Returns complete shards for multi-file specification snapshots. Each item contains FileName and DownloadUrl. For single files, use DownloadUrl
DownloadFiles.description_zh: 多文件规范快照时返回完整分片，每项包含 FileName、DownloadUrl；单文件使用 DownloadUrl

DownloadUrl.description_en: The HTTPS temporary download URL of the current shard. The validity period is specified by the outer ExpiresIn field
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 本分片的 HTTPS 临时下载地址，有效期由外层 ExpiresIn 给出

FileName.description_en: The file name of the specification YAML shard. Multiple shards form the complete model. It does not represent the object identity
FileName.description_zh: 规范 YAML 分片文件名；多个分片组成完整模型，不是对象身份

DownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL of the uploaded original file for DOCUMENT. For SEMANTIC_MODEL, it is the temporary download URL of the complete specification YAML for the current version
DownloadUrl.description_zh: DOCUMENT 上传原文件的临时下载地址；SEMANTIC_MODEL 为当前版本完整规范 YAML 的临时下载地址

Editable.description_en: Indicates whether the current caller has full content editing permissions. The value is true for OWNER and ADMIN, and false for VIEWER. Write operations still require re-authentication
Editable.description_zh: 当前调用者是否具备完整内容编辑权限；OWNER、ADMIN 为 true，VIEWER 为 false，写入仍重新鉴权

ExpiresIn.description_en: The validity period of the download URL, fixed at 300 seconds
ExpiresIn.description_zh: 下载链接有效期，固定 300 秒

FileName.description_en: The original file name of the uploaded document. This field is read-only. Renaming the object does not change this value. This field is not returned for external documents and semantic models
FileName.description_zh: 上传文档的原始文件名，只读；重命名 Name 不改变该值；外部文档和语义模型不返回

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base

KnowledgeObjectId.description_en: Located by type. Semantic models use the semantic layer model ID. Documents use a stable ID generated by the local document table. Callers must not parse the ID or use the retrieval ID
KnowledgeObjectId.description_zh: 按类型定位：语义模型沿用语义层 modelId；文档使用本地文档表生成的稳定 ID；调用者不解析 ID，不使用检索 ID

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the object was modified, in milliseconds. This value is used for conditional updates of the DOCUMENT body. This field does not indicate that optimistic lock updates are supported for semantic models
ModifyTime.description_zh: 对象修改时间，单位为毫秒。DOCUMENT 正文条件更新使用该值；该字段不表示语义模型已支持乐观锁更新

Name.description_en: The user-facing name, which is editable. Renaming the object does not change the KnowledgeObjectId
Name.description_zh: 面向用户的名称，可编辑；重命名不改变 KnowledgeObjectId

SizeBytes.description_en: The size of the uploaded original file in bytes. This field is read-only. It does not represent the length of the edited body
SizeBytes.description_zh: 上传原文件的字节数，只读；不是编辑后的正文长度

SourceReferences.description_en: The array of source references. Currently, an empty array is returned
SourceReferences.description_zh: 来源引用数组，当前返回空数组

SourceId.description_en: This field exists only when the type is KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE. It represents the KnowledgeSource.SourceId registered in the current knowledge base
SourceId.description_zh: 仅 KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE 时存在，本库登记的 KnowledgeSource.SourceId

Type.description_en: The category of the source reference. The structure retains KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE. Currently, SourceReferences is an empty array
Type.description_zh: 来源引用类别，结构保留 KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE；当前 SourceReferences 为空数组

Type.description_en: The current type, which can be SEMANTIC_MODEL or DOCUMENT. This field is extensible in the future
Type.description_zh: 当前 SEMANTIC_MODEL 或 DOCUMENT；未来可扩展

VersionNo.description_en: The version of the SEMANTIC_MODEL read in the current request. This version is used to specify the version for subsequent saves. It is not an optimistic lock
VersionNo.description_zh: SEMANTIC_MODEL 本次读取的版本；用于后续保存指定版本，不是乐观锁

Message.description_en: The secure error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
